therapyUpdates.notes: Original study's device-description section (PDF p.3) identifies a self-expanding, flexible double-disc device made from nitinol-braided wires. Exact polymer/coating was not disclosed there; do not add one without a device-specific IFU.
FDA SSED p.2 identifies size-specific sutures in addition to the frame, leaflet tissue and polyester graft already listed. Apply the material roles only to the corresponding TPV size.

Cross-file material conflict: therapy YAML calls NaviSeal UHMWPE, while the catalog spec calls it polyethylene. The Abbott IFU is shared, but its exact material table/page was not verified during this pass; retain the conflict for direct IFU review rather than silently asserting either label.

findings.summary: Navitor is the Portico-lineage PMA P190023 device after S002; 2022 IFU sizes predate 35 mm Titan added by S013. NaviSeal material is recorded as PE in catalog vs UHMWPE in therapy data; direct IFU locator resolution remains open.

CE-marked; no FDA authorization located. Boston Scientific disclosed its Q2 2025 decision to discontinue worldwide sales of ACURATE neo2 and Prime; this is product sales discontinuation, not a patient implant recall.
PMA P250024 approved 2026-03-17 for symptomatic severe native AR in high-or-greater surgical risk patients; S003 is a later 2026-07-09 supplement. Version and locator remain distinct.

The HDE-to-PMA sequence is correctly represented. SSED verifies platinum-iridium frame and bovine jugular valve tissue; fixation suture polymer is not specified in the cited SSED and remains unresolved.

PMA scope is native or surgically repaired RVOT severe PR; composition includes nitinol, polyester graft, porcine pericardium, and TPV-size-specific permanent sutures. Catalog clarification added for TPV22 vs TPV25.

Reviewed base SAPIEN 3 product spec: balloon-expandable cobalt-chromium frame, bovine-pericardial leaflets and ThermaFix tissue; native AS risk scope and high-risk valve-in-valve indication remain separated.

S141 is a tissue/design-change approval without dedicated public SSED or RESILIA-specific sizing table; shared Ultra IFU supports platform attributes only. Existing not-publicly-disclosed size field is appropriate.
FDA FX generation entered under S094; catalog lacked durable frame and leaflet materials, now added from the device-description section of the IFU.
FX+ is a design/manufacturing generation introduced by S155 with larger frame windows; it retains its own distinct material/spec row from FX.
G4 adds NTW/XTW and independent/simultaneous gripper actuation over prior configurations; materials are represented at family therapy level.
G5 is a delivery handle/IFU redesign on the unchanged G4 implant; 2025 S078 clarifies preparation steps and does not constitute an indication expansion.
G5 delivery handle/IFU update carries the G4 implant. Its decision should not be read as a new implant material version or indication expansion.
FDA PMA P220003 is scoped to degenerative MR for prohibitive surgical risk; the catalog retains a distinct central-spacer device/material profile.
PMA P240042 authorization covers severe MAC-associated mitral valve dysfunction for patients unsuitable for surgery/TEER; materials and apical tether are version-specific.
PMA P250019 (2025-12-22) is a separate transseptal TMVR system and authorization from Tendyne; the 2026 process supplement does not replace the original approval record.

Investigational version is not FDA authorized; APOLLO transapical lineage and newer transseptal feasibility protocol are different access-system study contexts. Exact commercial availability and final transseptal version status remain unverified.
Original PMA P230013 is severe symptomatic TR despite OMT. September 2026 supplement S027 exists; it is post-approval history, not a new therapy lineage.
Public evidence remains a single first-in-human case; textile ingrowth skirt polymer is not disclosed, so no skirt material should be inferred.
CE-marked direct annuloplasty for mitral and later tricuspid use; no US PMA identified. Reviewed source gives six sizes but not exact lengths, and the exact labeling lifecycle remains uncertain.

Dedicated PVL device has observational clinical evidence and original-study description of a nitinol-braided double disc; FDA authorization not identified. Therapy materials remain empty pending owner update.

ReChord remains an IDE investigation (registry status active, not recruiting at cited 2026 update). Product/implant material and non-US market status need an exact SSCP locator review before populating the empty materials list.

FDA De Novo granted 2024-06-11 for surgical replacement of adult mitral chordae under direct visualization. FDA p.5 explicitly identifies permanent ePTFE suture and titanium fastener; therapy YAML currently omits both.

EU CE-marked; US IDE remains investigational/no FDA approval identified. Manufacturer material table distinguishes SVC and IVC skirt composition; catalog now contains sourced composition but legacy therapy has no materials.
TRICAVAL studied off-label IVC implantation of the separately approved SAPIEN XT; trial terminated for safety concerns. This does not establish withdrawal of SAPIEN XT from its labeled aortic uses.

AVP III appears in observational PVL closure data, but PVL-specific FDA authorization was not found. Do not infer composition from AVP/AVP II generations; exact AVP III-specific IFU materials remain unverified.

Manufacturer leaflet identifies porcine pericardium, PTFE suture, nitinol stent and gold markers. Therapy data omit materials; family developer name matches leaflet, though other clinical publications use MEDIRA and current corporate relationship is unresolved.
